Product description

PRODUCT STORY : Where tradition meets modern edge. This polo updates a timeless silhouette with a zippered placket that adds a sleek, contemporary touch. Designed for those who prefer their classics with a twist, it’s made to keep your everyday style sharp and effortless. DETAILS : Sleeve: Short sleeve, Neckline: Collar with zip placket, Fit: Slim, Construction: Knitted, Fabric Type: Knit.
